data.original_title: Rena Vale: Shadow of the Highway
data.overview: This documentary examines Rena Vale, a rare case of a woman convicted of a series of murders. Tracing a childhood marked by abuse through years on death row, it revisits the crimes and the revelations that reshaped her story.
data.tagline: A life seen from the final mile.
data.title: Rena Vale: Shadow of the Highway
